proceso.title: How I work
proceso.intro: An end-to-end method: from the problem to the data that confirms the goal was met. Six stages that feed one another.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.desc: Interviews, data and business context to separate the real problem from the symptom before proposing a solution.

steps.title: UX
steps.desc: I turn findings into architecture and flows: what the user sees, in what order and why.

steps.title: Prototyping
steps.desc: Clickable prototypes to validate with real users before committing development.

steps.title: Development
steps.desc: Functional definition and coordination with the technical team, from roadmap to release.

steps.title: Launch
steps.desc: I ship with control: feature flags, progressive rollout and A/B testing before exposing the change to every user.

steps.title: Analytics
steps.desc: Instrumentation and metrics to measure real impact and feed the next discovery.

masAlla.line1b: once. From what didn't work out, I learned what no framework teaches.
masAlla.line2: Before that, years acquiring users — before measuring product, I understood how you attract them.

trayectoria.title: Career
trayectoria.productoIntro: Ten years leading product in B2B and B2C SaaS — from founder with an exit to Product Manager at startups and scale-ups — with a constant focus on discovery, UX and measurable results.
trayectoria.previoIntro: This earlier stage in marketing and growth builds the analytical, experimentation and user-first foundation that defines my approach as a Product Manager.

producto.desc: Led the digitalization of Sales & Operations and evolved the LISA AI agent; I report directly to the CEO, on the leadership team alongside Operations, Finance and Tech.
Validated the review-fraud problem and designed the MVP with voice verification and AI; as cofounder, I supported the CEO in the pre-seed fundraising.
Redesigned pricing and onboarding to improve activation and reduce churn; reported to the CPO/cofounder, leading by influence without formal authority.
Researched and defined features for the contributors area; improved onboarding (sign-up, emailing, profile quality) from qualitative and quantitative analysis with design.

nested.desc: Cofounder with a vote on the key decisions; led product, roadmap and the no-code team (backend, frontend, design).
Professionalized the agency's structure and service portfolio; that work funded the launch of TheTool.

previo.desc: Organic growth from 3.2M to 9.4M monthly visits; shifted the business model from intrusive installers to valuable content and video monetization — the start of my turn toward product-first.
Acquisition and performance at leading agencies — the analytics, CRO, UX and leadership foundation that enabled the jump to product.

toolkit.title: Toolkit
toolkit.intro: Tools are means, not ends. These are some that have helped me do my job better and hit my goals.

tools.name: Amplitude
tools.desc: I define funnels and cohorts to see where and why users drop off.

tools.name: Google Analytics
tools.desc: Acquisition and aggregate behavior at the top of the funnel.

tools.name: Microsoft Clarity
tools.desc: Heatmaps and recordings to see the real friction on screen.

tools.name: Typeform
tools.desc: Surveys and concept tests to validate hypotheses before building.

tools.name: Jira
tools.desc: I organize roadmap and sprints, with traceability from discovery to delivery.

tools.name: Notion
tools.desc: My source of truth for specs, decisions and living documentation.

tools.name: Miro
tools.desc: I map user journeys and facilitate discovery and prioritization with the team.

tools.name: Mermaid.js
tools.desc: I document flows as versionable diagrams alongside the specs.

tools.name: Claude Design
tools.desc: I explore visual direction and generate clickable mockups very early.

tools.name: Figma
tools.desc: I prototype clickable flows and align with design before building.

tools.name: v0
tools.desc: I generate first UI versions to iterate fast on real ideas.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.desc: I build functional prototypes and automate tasks myself.

tools.name: VS Code
tools.desc: My editor to read the code and make small changes.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.desc: I deploy prototypes and previews to validate in minutes.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.desc: I follow PRs, releases and issues close to the development pulse.
